messages:
jordan: Heads-up — hybrid all-hands going live in 3 min. Lobby report: remote panel video looks fine but the auditorium wall screen is stuck on a single tile. anyone near AV?
anya: On it. I see OBS preview locked to the keynote camera. trying a soft-reload of the scene collection.
michael: Reminder: please keep questions in this thread so we can triage and pin them for leadership Q&A.
ops-bot: Recording will start in 120 seconds. 
anya: Soft-reload didn't help. switching to backup scene → swapping to HDMI pool B now.
dina: Audience audio sounds low from the room mics, remote callers fine. can someone flip the mixer gain +3dB?
jordan: @dina done. also toggled NDI output on the switch — that freed the wall screen. tile responsiveness back but captions are delayed ~15s.
michael: thanks. Lia, do you want to delay slide share for 2-3 minutes so captions catch up?
ceo-lia: Let's start on time. we'll do quick verbal callouts for slide numbers and then reopen for recorded Q&A if captions need fixes. short answers only.
anya: Captions service is showing quota spikes on the bridge. i'm restarting caption-worker (command: `systemctl restart caption-worker.service`) — should be <60s.
recording-bot: Recording started at 2098765460. File: allhands_2098765460.mp4
ops-bot: OBS scene collection fallback engaged: scene_backup_02.
dina: Room mic gain looks good now. can someone confirm remote panel audio back to normal?
michael: remote panel audible and wall screen fixed, captions catching up.
jordan: Quick ops note: if anyone on the stage changes mics, tag @anya so we can hotpatch routing.
ceo-lia: Q for leadership: roadmap clarity — are we still tracking the Dedicated autoscaling launch for late Q3?
michael: yes, core infra is green; dedicated autoscaling still target late Q3, small risk on driver certs but on path.
ceo-lia: Thanks — that'll do for now. we'll capture followups in Notion. please paste any unanswered questions here and we'll route them to the right PM/Eng owner.
jordan: Follow-up: who owns the captions SLA? want to add a preflight check to the all-hands runbook.
anya: that's me and infra-ml team. i'll add the checklist item (`caption-worker healthcheck`, `NDI toggles`, `fallback scene`) and link the runbook PR after the meeting.
dina: Can we get the recording trimmed for the first 90s (dead air) before publishing?
recording-bot: Logged trimming request by dina -> job 8237 queued. ETA ~5m post-meeting.
michael: I'll collect chat Qs and paste top 5 for the leadership panel after the first segment.
ceo-lia: Perfect. thanks everyone for the quick fixes.
jordan: closing ops loop: wall screen tile issue root cause = OBS scene collection stuck on GPU texture; workaround = scene reload or switch to backup. we'll open a ticket for a longer-term fix. :white_check_mark:
